title: (To be deprecated) Get the dynamic quota on Legacy Smart+ Campaigns
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get the dynamic quota on the number of active Smart+ Campaigns within an ad account. > **Important**
> - **Upgraded Smart+ API**: > - We are actively upgrading the Smart+ API to deliver enhanced capabilities and performance. The new Upgraded Smart+ API is already launched. Learn more about [Upgraded Smart+ Campaign](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1853452461203458) and [available Upgraded Smart+ API endpoints](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1843301794874370). > - **Get started**: > - **Reporting**: No additional allowlist required. > - **Campaign Management**: To access the upgraded Smart+ experience, contact your TikTok sales representative to have your ad account allowlisted. If your ad account is already in the allowlist, you can directly use the Upgraded Smart+ API creation and modification endpoints. > - **Legacy API Deprecation**: > - After **March 31, 2026**, you will no longer be able to create legacy Smart+ Campaigns using the [/campaign/spc/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1767334204047362) endpoint. > - Note that legacy Smart+ Campaigns that have not been migrated will not be transitioned to the new API automatically. Attempts to use the legacy Smart+ API endpoint afterward will result in errors, rendering new campaign creation via this endpoint unavailable. > - **Legacy API deprecation extension request process for existing legacy Smart+ creation developers**: > - 1. **Submit a request**: If you require an extension, please submit an application via the [External Extension Request Form for Legacy Smart+ Creation API](https://bytedance.sg.larkoffice.com/share/base/form/shrlgsm2yMsQaSoAsMy77tcAzng). > - 2. **Allowlist processing**: After receiving your request, we will process an allowlist entry for the associated developer app ID. After the process, developers will be able to continue calling the `/campaign/spc/create/` endpoint until **June 30, 2026**. > - 3. **Extended timeline for strong business needs**: If you have a strong business case requiring an extension beyond June 30, 2026, please specify your use case in the application form, or contact your sales representative directly. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/spc/quota/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/spc/quota/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}' \ --header 'Access-token: {{Access-token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data|object|Returned data.| #|total_quota|number|The total quota of active Smart+ Campaigns for the ad account.| #|used_quota|number|The number of active Smart+ Campaigns within the ad account.| #|used_campaign_ids|string[]|Returned only when `used_quota` is greater than 0.

The IDs of the active Smart+ Campaigns within the ad account.

To disable active Smart+ Campaigns, use [/campaign/status/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739320994354178) with `operation_status` set to `DISABLE`.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "active_campaign_ids": [ "{{active_campaign_id}}", "{{active_campaign_id}}" ], "total_quota": 50, "used_quota": 2 } } (/code) ```
